description: Structured debugging workflow with hypothesis-driven investigation using Tree of Thought (ToT) methodology. Generates ranked hypotheses with testable predictions, applies scientific method to root cause analysis. Routes to Trivial (direct fix), Quick (TDD cycle), or Complex (full investigation). Multi-source research via Context7 MCP, WebSearch, Perplexity suggestions. Auto-detects stack skills (Django, React, Spring, Symfony, Tailwind) for patterns. Use when: debugging errors, fixing bugs, investigating issues, troubleshooting. Triggers: debug, fix bug, investigate error, troubleshoot, find root cause. Not for: performance optimization (use /improve), refactoring (use /refactor).
